(()=>{const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Estimate'); if(!b) return 'NO ESTIMATE BTN'; b.click(); return 'clicked Estimate';})()

(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.industry-picker select'); if(!s) return 'NO PICKER'; const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(s,'quantity-surveying'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'selected='+s.value;})()
